name: Lady's-Slipper Orchid
desc: Lady's-Slipper Orchid (Cypripedium acaule): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Cypripedium acaule, the pink lady's slipper or moccasin flower, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family Orchidaceae native to eastern North America.
